desc:
• PANCAKE MIX: Buttermilk pancake mix that makes fluffy, mouth-watering pancakes, waffles and more

  • QUICK AND EASY: Quick and easy breakfast option; just add water to pancake mix and pour onto griddle

  • WIN THE MORNING: This baking mix is a simple way to win over the family with delicious pancakes

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Easy to customize with fruits, nuts or chocolate chips

  • EASY BREAKFAST IDEA: Use easy baking mix to make a crowd-pleasing breakfast option anytime

  • BOX TOPS FOR EDUCATION PARTICIPATING PRODUCT: Give back to schools with Betty Crocker; Download the Box Tops App to learn more & start earning cash for your school or a school in need
features:
Features

Quick and Easy Preparation
Just add water—no eggs or milk needed, making it fast and hassle-free.

Classic Buttery Pancake Flavor
Delivers a soft, golden pancake with a familiar home-style taste and aroma.

Fluffy yet Light Texture
Balanced batter creates pancakes that are fluffy on the inside with lightly crisp edges.

Versatile Use
Ideal for pancakes, waffles, crepes, or as a base for muffins and quick breads.

Family-Sized Box
Large enough to serve several breakfasts, perfect for households or meal prep.

Trusted Ingredients
Made with enriched flour and natural flavoring—simple and reliable.

Trusted Brand Quality
Produced by Betty Crocker, ensuring consistent performance and quality.

Benefits

Effortless Mornings
Saves time and effort—just mix, cook, and enjoy.

Perfect for All Skill Levels
Easy for beginners, practical for parents, and consistent enough for pros.

Cost-Effective and Space-Saving
Large volume for multiple meals in a compact, pantry-friendly package.

Customizable and Fun
Enhance with berries, nuts, chocolate chips, or spices to suit different tastes.

Crowd-Pleasing Option
Great for family breakfasts, brunch gatherings, and overnight guests—simple and satisfying.

Adaptable Texture
Adjust water amounts for thicker or thinner batters to suit your cooking style.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Rice Flour, Defatted Soy Flour, Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate), Dextrose, Salt, DATEM, Calcium Carbonate.
